policy: M0 first. All tasks planned, not implemented. Assign base revisions and leases at execution; only one canonical integrator.

tasks.goal: Freeze minimal M0 ABI, numeric/effect contract, error codes and fixtures; assign owners.
acceptance: Headers describe sizes/lifetimes/statuses and M0 only.
Independent fixture review; contract consumers can implement without guessing.

tasks.goal: Inventory/pin tools and dependencies; create small C17 native build and platform skeleton.
acceptance: T00 clean native build with real version/command evidence.
No mandatory JIT/GPU dependency; small independent targets.

tasks.goal: Implement strict JSON SU-LIR decoder and semantic verifier.
acceptance: T03/T04 malformed, typed/effect, duplicate/limit tests pass.
Valid examples normalize consistently.

tasks.goal: Implement fixed SoA u32 table, staged outputs and committed/working roots.
acceptance: Zero/edge row counts and overflow-safe size checks.
Working-root failures never publish partial state.

tasks.goal: Implement reference VM and deterministic serial invocation.
acceptance: T01/T02/T03 fixtures match exact expected fields.
Invocation-entry reads and one staged store per writable field.

tasks.goal: Implement local supervisor/worker lifecycle and bounded structured control.
acceptance: T10/T15 candidate isolation and structured errors.
No public listener or native candidate execution in supervisor.

tasks.goal: Create independent fixture, negative and end-to-end test harness inputs.
acceptance: Known-answer fixtures cover wrap, empty data and intentional behavior edit.
Expected results independent of VM output; no fake runtime passes.

tasks.goal: Implement version registry, prepared schedule, safe-point capsule publication.
acceptance: T05/T06/T07/T11 preserve PID/state; reject invalid/stale revisions.
Record exact effective tick and semantic revisions.

tasks.goal: Implement canonical snapshots/restore and committed checkpoint ownership.
acceptance: T08/T09 round-trip exact state/manifest; no partial tick publication.
Checkpoint costs and retained memory are observable.

tasks.goal: Wire reproducible no-build gameplay demo and full M0 integration checks.
acceptance: T00–T15 runtime evidence, with timings reported as actuals.
T12 instrumentation proves no compiler/assembler/linker on capsule edit.

tasks.goal: Measure decomposed live latency and native build latency; document real commands.
acceptance: Warm/cold and queue/boundary costs separated.
All unmeasured counters are null; publish real sample data.

tasks.goal: Independent M0 closure audit and accepted-source checkpoint.
acceptance: Verifier reproduces required demo and gates on exact tree.
M0 not closed on missing native tests; next M1 handoff explicit.

tasks.goal: Add bounded build/specialization broker and freeze native invocation ABI.
acceptance: Durable deduplicated jobs and stale-result rejection.
Actual ABI tests and compilation; no gameplay build dependency.

tasks.goal: Implement one AsmJit scalar SU-LIR backend behind the C ABI.
acceptance: All supported opcodes match reference corpus.
W^X, failure handling, source maps and actual platform calling convention.

tasks.goal: Qualify native isolation, code lifetime, cache invalidation and recovery.
acceptance: No stale pointers after repeated swaps or in-flight jobs.
Native worker crash recovery records replaced PID and correct checkpoint replay.

tasks.goal: Add capability-checked AVX2 lowering only after scalar qualification.
acceptance: Zero/tails/unaligned/overflow corpus exact.
Real isolated throughput and end-to-end cost; scalar fallback works.

tasks.goal: Add disjoint chunk scheduling and canonical effect merge tests.
acceptance: Serial/parallel canonical results match for varied completion orders.
Conflicts and ordering cycles rejected.

tasks.goal: Qualify Windows/platform paths and small-agent throughput experiment.
acceptance: Actual Linux/Windows results distinguished from not-run environments.
Queue/rework/accepted-task metrics before increasing agent count.

tasks.goal: Introduce generational entities, chunked schemas and bounded structural events.
acceptance: Stale handles, churn and deterministic event merge validated.
IR extensions versioned with verifier/reference/backend tests.

tasks.goal: Implement additive and explicit destructive schema migrations.
acceptance: Memory failure, rollback and layout invalidation tests.
Large migrations separated from small code-reload timing.

tasks.goal: Establish BFME variant/evidence registry and one behavior adapter slice.
acceptance: Version-labelled confirmed/inferred/unknown behavior evidence.
No original assets in public artifacts; fidelity versus regression separated.

tasks.goal: Add command replay and headless multi-peer development tests.
acceptance: Manifest pinning and controlled delay/loss/reorder tests.
Explicit transport limits, input validation and desync diagnostics.

tasks.goal: Add minimal presentation and granular asset pipeline after headless gates.
acceptance: Committed snapshot boundary, resource retirement and device capability tests.
No synchronous broad asset cook/shader build on ordinary gameplay edit.

tasks.goal: Freeze the M3 RTS microcosm contract (r4); owner accepts or rejects OD-1 to OD-21.
acceptance: Owner accepts or rejects each open OD in section 13 and the items in section 17.

tasks.goal: RTS schema, single normative Python scene generator, scene lock.
acceptance: Generator reproducible; digests stable; PRNG and field-order mutants change digests; remainder rule 7.3; anchor idle values 7.3.

tasks.goal: Independent Python reference model, IR evaluator and targeting oracle.
acceptance: 10.1 known answers including the exact ring fixture; IR-vs-model differential; oracle budget (8); targeting metrics (4.2) at 1,024 queriers; model author does not read M3-04 sources.

tasks.goal: Capsule schema edit (OD-16): system_rev, capabilities, host variant, rts_u32_v1 profile name, host limits values.
acceptance: Existing IR capsules validate unchanged; IR and host variants validate; rts_u32_v1 accepted; max_rows above 1,000,000 refused; unknown top-level key refused; no other key changes.

tasks.goal: IR systems goal, combat, move and damage; IR authoring tool; IR capsule records.
acceptance: 10.4 negatives; regenerate-equality; measured instruction counts recorded; 5.5 record fields and 3.2 after lists.

tasks.goal: Scheduler host-entry kind (OD-1b): dispatch, declared effects, restore, handler refusals, host capsule records, host registry.
acceptance: IR entries unchanged (T-HOST-01); T-HOST-02..13; targeted compile with and without SU_HAVE_NATIVE; existing scheduler, tick-worker, entity-tick and reload tests pass unchanged.

tasks.goal: Host operators rts.spatial and rts.scatter (spatial index, gather, scatter) and their production descriptors.
acceptance: 10.1 SPATIAL, GATHER, SCATTER; ASan and UBSan; instrumented store-set check (4.4); fault seams (N9); descriptors equal the M3-04a host records (T-HOST-05).

tasks.goal: world.set_fields and world.spawn_batch; spawn defaults and batch atomicity; admission prechecks; structural buffer caps (OD-20); replay record and replay; checkpoint recovery.
acceptance: T-RTS-LOAD-1 (a)-(g); T-RTS-CTRL-1; T-RTS-REPLAY-1..3; T-RTS-CAPS-1..3 (CAPS-3 confirmed at 699,051 before the patch); high-water and spool prechecks; config check (9.4); recovery-log entries; OD-3c exclusion recorded. Needs OD-3, OD-3b, OD-3c and OD-20 approval.

tasks.goal: End-to-end suite, golden scenes, edge fixtures, mutation campaign, targeting gates.
acceptance: C equals Python digests for committed scenes within oracle limits; 10.6 gates with the thin-margin rule; listed mutants detected or recorded as equivalent or unrun; M3-M27 detected by the per-tick model comparison (15).

tasks.goal: Agent-authored behaviours experiment: B3, B2, B1 through the candidate pipeline.
acceptance: Records per section 11; hidden fixtures written by a different party; each fixture fails on the baseline and on the last accepted candidate; no direct edits to capsules/rts/ on the canonical branch.

tasks.goal: Exact per-root memory accounting API (OD-10); optional for M3-08.
acceptance: Per-category bytes match the 9.3 table within stated tolerance; without it 9.3 figures stay estimates. Needs owner approval (OD-10).

tasks.goal: Stress curves and memory methodology; spool comment correction.
acceptance: Raw logs with hashes, hardware blocks, named limits and null reasons; no predeclared unit-count claims; recovery claim per 12; comment matches 9.3 (588,630 rows at default settings).

tasks.goal: Independent review of any M3 performance optimization.
acceptance: C10 evidence present; reviewer differs from author; digests unchanged.

tasks.goal: Optional native lane for goal, combat and move.
acceptance: Differential against reference VM across row tails and dead rows; capability fallback. Requires M1 owner acceptance (OD-11).
